pages.text: Straw piled like a mountain in the mill yard. Dad laid a long wooden board along its slope.
"I want to slide down that board and land in the straw!" Mumu hopped and hopped.
Dodo climbed onto the board. "Bone-dry slides are fastest. No wet feathers either! I know!"
She sat on the dry board and pushed herself forward.
Creeeak. Dodo stuck fast and stopped. She crawled slowly, like a grub.
"This is... a sightseeing slide." Dodo wiggled her bottom.
Mumu looked at the lower board. Waterwheel splashes had made it wet and shiny. His wing brushed it. Slippery!
Mumu sprinkled water over the board with a watering can.
Zoom! Mumu slid and plunged into the straw. Straw fluttered everywhere.
Dodo zoomed down too. Plop! "A wet slide is a hundred times better!" Straw stuck out of all their feathers.
